en: Dragon Ball: Curse of the Blood Rubies
orig: ドラゴンボール 神龍の伝説
plotEn:
Since finding the Blood Rubies (リッチストーン, Ricchi Sutōn; Ritch Stones), King Gurumes has fallen under a curse that turns him into a large, purple monster and makes his hunger insatiable. He hopes to wish the curse away with the Dragon Balls. Gurumes' soldiers have destroyed the homes and lands of farmers within his kingdom in their search for Blood Rubies. A little girl, Pansy, decides to go and seek help.
Goku, a young monkey-tailed boy with special strength, lives alone in the wilderness of Mount Paozu. He encounters Bulma, a teenage girl who is also searching for the Dragon Balls. Goku tells her that his grandpa gave him a Dragon Ball before he died. Gurumes' two main enforcers, Pasta and Bongo, arrive at Goku's home and steal his Dragon Ball. They flee in their fighter jet, but Goku uses his Power Pole to defeat them. Later that night, Goku and Bulma find Pansy being accosted by Oolong, who has the ability to shape-shift into various forms. Oolong flees when Goku proves his strength by destroying a large tree. Goku chases Oolong and knocks him down with his Power Pole, reverting him back to his true form, a pig. Yamcha and his sidekick Puar threaten Oolong and Goku after they end up in Yamcha's territory. Goku fights back against Yamcha, but their duel is cut short when Bulma arrives. Yamcha is paralyzed in fear at the sight of Bulma and falls off a cliff, before he and Puar retreat.
